elements.description:
A matrix of which agent may use which tools and scopes – Allow, Ask or Deny per cell – with presets and a summary of
what changed.

properties.name: heading
properties.description: The heading, and the grid's name

properties.name: tools
properties.description: The rows: each tool's scopes, grouped under the tool

properties.name: value
properties.description: The matrix. Changed by the user unless a tc-value-change listener calls preventDefault()

properties.name: saved
properties.description: What was last saved – the summary lists the differences. Unset: the value the element first showed

properties.name: defaultLevel
properties.description: A cell missing from the value

properties.name: presets
properties.default: [ { id: "read-only", label: "Read only", description: "Safe scopes allowed, everything else denied", level: (s) => ((s.risk ?? "safe") === "safe" ? "allow" : "deny") }, { id: "ask-first", label: "Ask first", description: "Safe scopes allowed, the rest ask every time", level: (s) => ((s.risk ?? "safe") === "safe" ? "allow" : "ask") }, { id: "trusted", label: "Trusted", description: "Only destructive scopes ask", level: (s) => (s.risk === "destructive" ? "ask" : "allow") }, { id: "locked", label: "Locked", description: "Every scope asks", level: () => "ask" }, ]

properties.name: saveLabel
properties.description: The Save button's text; the number of changes is shown beside it

properties.name: resetLabel
properties.description: The text of the button that puts back what was last saved

properties.name: look
properties.description: Visual style: "standard" or "clean"; unset follows <tc-look-provider>, else "standard"

events.name: tc-value-change
events.description: A cell, a preset or Reset changed the matrix ({ value, changes, cause }: ToolPermissionValueChange); cancelable

events.name: tc-save
events.description: Save was pressed ({ value, changes }: ToolPermissionSave); cancelable – unless prevented, `saved` becomes the value

functions.name: defaultToolPermissionPresets
functions.description: The presets used when the page gives none: they read each scope's risk

props.name: title
props.description: The heading, and the grid's name

props.name: agents
props.description: The columns: one per agent, with an optional avatar node and model name

props.name: tools
props.description: The rows: each tool's scopes, grouped under the tool

props.name: defaultValue
props.description: The matrix on mount when `value` isn't controlled – a missing cell is `defaultLevel`

props.name: onChange
props.description: A cell, a preset or Reset changed the matrix; `detail` says which and lists the changes since the last save

props.name: saved
props.description: What was last saved – controlled when given; otherwise the first value, then whatever Save stores

props.name: onSave
props.description: Save was pressed – store the value; the summary then starts from it

changelog: `tc-tool-permissions` – a grid of agents × tool scopes, allow / ask / deny per cell (a destructive scope never offers allow), presets, a Custom state, and a summary of changes against `saved`. WAI-ARIA grid; `tc-value-change` with the cause, `tc-save`.
